title: Political Narratives in the 2024 Moldovan Presidential Election: Stance, Amplification, and Influence
abstract: arXiv:2610.22464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media platforms play a central role in shaping political discourse during elections, particularly in geopolitically contested regions. We study how political narratives emerged, aligned, and propagated during the 2024 Moldovan presidential election by analyzing publicly available posts collected from X, Facebook, and Reddit between August and October 2024. Combining multilingual stance detection, coordination analysis, and causal inference, we examine both descriptive and causal mechanisms underlying online political discourse. First, we apply large language models to classify stance toward European integration, Russia, and the two main presidential candidates, revealing clear cross-platform and cross-linguistic differences in how political positions are expressed. translated_title: 2024年摩尔多瓦总统选举中的政治叙事：立场、放大与影响
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台在选举期间塑造政治话语方面发挥着核心作用，尤其是在地缘政治争议地区。我们通过分析2024年8月至10月期间从X、Facebook和Reddit收集的公开帖子，研究2024年摩尔多瓦总统选举期间政治叙事如何产生、趋同与传播。通过结合多语言立场检测、协同行为分析和因果推断，我们考察了在线政治话语背后的描述性机制与因果机制。首先，我们应用大语言模型对针对欧洲一体化、俄罗斯以及两位主要总统候选人的立场进行分类，揭示了政治立场表达方式上明显的跨平台与跨语言差异。其次，我们在X平台上构建基于转发的网络和语义对齐网络，以识别主导叙事的放大行为和一致的叙事框架。最后，我们使用一种……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究结合多语言立场检测、协同行为分析和因果推断，揭示了2024年摩尔多瓦总统选举期间社交媒体上政治叙事的跨平台立场差异、放大机制及其传播影响。
en_tdlr: This study combines multilingual stance detection, coordination analysis, and causal inference to reveal cross-platform stance differences, amplification mechanisms, and the propagation of political narratives on social media during the 2024 Moldovan presidential election.
